description: Documented ShoppingMate Biz API read-only client; no login, key management, link issuance or conversion implementation. Synthetic tests do not establish live authentication. Dashboard profile/content CRUD and general CPA/CPI/CPC campaign operations are outside this documented shopping API scope.

capabilities.title: Verify intended owner, API approval and protected key propagation
capabilities.blocker: Google rejected the working browser; no owner/API approval or key obtained. No login/key-management client is implemented.

capabilities.title: Read documented merchant summaries and returned commission links
capabilities.blocker: Client and synthetic tests exist; actual authorized key, account eligibility and independent business replay are unverified.

capabilities.title: Read bounded product search with original formatted reference prices
capabilities.blocker: No live key replay. No documented exact product/option/seller identity; no rights or verified-offer claim.

capabilities.title: Read a random bounded area sample with numeric reference prices
capabilities.blocker: No live key replay; not a rank or exhaustive catalogue. Actual count/list contract must be checked against the abbreviated guide example.

capabilities.title: Journal an exact authorized source target and verify a provider-issued link without duplicate issuance
capabilities.blocker: Link/directlink operations are intentionally not implemented in this read-only client. Owner, destination and eligibility proof remain absent.

capabilities.title: Establish merchant-specific product/image reuse and commission eligibility
capabilities.blocker: Adpick documentation grants no product/image storage or reuse rights; independent merchant scope is unverified.

capabilities.title: Read private conversion reports under intended owner and whitelisted egress
capabilities.blocker: No conversion client, account key or confirmed IP whitelist. Vercel dynamic egress is not eligibility proof; no billing/network change authorized.
